description: A FACTUAL reference record for a member of the judiciary (name, court, role, official public biography) ingested from pre-published public records into the etzhayyim global judiciary corpus. R0 skeleton per ADR-2605302345 §D4/§D5. CONSTITUTIONAL (G19 — judge-analytics prohibition): this record exists for factual reference ONLY (who presides where). The system MUST NOT evaluate, analyse, compare, score, rank or predict a named judge's practices or decisions. France magistrates fall under loi n°2019-222 art. 33, which makes such reuse a CRIME (Code pénal art. 226-18, up to 5y); `noAnalytics` is the GLOBAL default and is hard-locked true for France. No analytics property (winRate / rulingPrediction / reversalRate / leanScore / decisionTendency / judgeScore / predictedOutcome) is representable at the schema layer. Ingestion is passive-only (danjo G3); litigant/third-party PII is pseudonymized (G6/D6).

jurisdiction.description: ISO jurisdiction, e.g. fra. For fra, noAnalytics is criminally mandated (loi 2019-222 art.33).

judgeName.description: Public name as published. Factual identity only.

role.description: Factual role. NOT a performance metric.

publicBioCid.description: Optional CID of the official public biography (court-published).

sourceRecordCids.description: ≥1 pre-published public-record CID (passive-ingestion provenance, danjo G3/G5).

noAnalytics.description: G19 anchor — MUST be true. Profiling/scoring/prediction of this judge is prohibited (criminal in France).

pseudonymizationApplied.description: Litigant/third-party PII in associated decisions is pseudonymized before projection (D6).
